description: Atlantic Americas. Connects the Caribbean with the North American Atlantic coast, carrying general cargo, coffee and agricultural products, manufactured goods and refrigerated cargo.
Pacific Americas. Connects the United States and Canada on the Pacific coast, carrying containerised general cargo, machinery and industrial components, forest products and refrigerated cargo.
Intercoastal Americas. Links the Atlantic and Pacific coasts through the Panama Canal, for long-distance shipments and transshipment between the two American services.
